# Cheap Web Hosting Server & True Cost Calculator

> Open-source comparison of cheap web hosting and Linux VPS servers based on real 1-3 year total cost, renewal rates, US data centers, and technical stack support.

- Web App: https://free-website-domains.github.io/cheap-web-hosting-server/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/free-website-domains/cheap-web-hosting-server
- Structured Data: /data/providers.json, /data/plans.json, /data/pricing-history.json
- CLI Tool: python3 hosting_finder.py --months 36 --max-budget 5 --us-only
